selection_reason.summary: Repeated unconvincing hurdle finishes leave him vulnerable to strong competition. Klic Boum's strong-running second on chase debut makes him the principal rival with this longer trip a plausible help. Sweet Caryline won three hurdles and can improve from her first chase run; Breezethroughlife has a breathing operation and drop in trip as plausible revival routes. Their limitations are that the latter two still need improvement or revival. Marlacoo's chase debut is an unknown, not evidence of poor jumping.
selection_reason.counterargument: He has underlying ability and could improve for fences; only four runners means relatively few rivals must disappoint for him to win. Chase inexperience is not itself a demonstrated defect.

selection_reason.summary: She has no commanding ability advantage after running below her April winning form. Enola Grey was third after trouble finishing last time and has course-winning form; Ribenska returns to all-weather seven furlongs on a slipping mark; Spirit Of Jenny is a course winner back on her winning mark. The main case is several credible rivals rather than a manufactured weight or pace negative. Enola Grey has prior poor runs, Ribenska needs a revival and Spirit Of Jenny has not progressed.
selection_reason.counterargument: Her latest sixth had excuses: she started poorly and closed late over six furlongs. Returning to seven furlongs, removal of the visor and a reduced mark of 69 offer a credible winning route.
